as_told.title: Lead Bell scientists Grawitz and Gerlach, per Witkowski

plain: The lead scientist of the Bell, a secret Nazi wartime project, was Ernst Grawitz, the SS medical chief, according to the Polish journalist Igor Witkowski, who wrote about the project. Michels raises this himself in two episodes from 2025, citing Witkowski and saying "we do know" it "for a fact"; in the second he adds that Grawitz worked directly under Josef Mengele. If true, it would tie the project to the Nazi regime's medical crimes.
